held_out_rule: declared before any M15 real-city result; not fetched, built or evaluated without authorisation
window_rule: earlier GHSL built-up sampling rules (M13 GEN: GHSL 2020 >= 0.15, random cap; M2 v1: stratified GHSL design); never street metrics. Strata assigned afterwards from GLO-30 slope

elevation.sensitivity: IGN MDT05 bare-earth DTM (Spain only, M13 terrain)

known_limitations: GLO-30 is a DSM: buildings and vegetation raise the surface; at 30 m, building blocks and street canyons can imprint the street pattern (leakage risk)
Korea and Peru were dropped in M2 for incomplete OSM building mapping; street completeness is not independently verified
Spanish development windows were used in M13/M14 for other questions
